transcript: My friend, most people think drinking water is simple, but my teacher, Dr. Li Zhongsheng, who lived to be 102, always told me, even the smallest daily habit can reshape your whole rhythm. And he taught me something beautiful. The way you drink water can support your energy and bring more harmony into your day. Habit 1. Temperature. Warm or room temperature water keeps your inner rhythm steady. Cold water may feel refreshing, but it disrupts your natural flow. Habit 2. Pace. Don't rush. Sip slowly, as if you're watering a delicate plant. Your body receives it more gently. Habit 3. Timing. Try not to drink large amounts while you eat. Give your body space, a little before or sometime after your meal. Habit 4. Night cup. My teacher always drank a small cup of warm water before bed. He said it helped him end the day with clarity and begin the next with calm. Habit 5. Balance. Not too little, not too much. Just the amount that helps you feel present and steady. These small habits may look simple, but practice daily. They can transform the way you move through life. If you want me to share more ancient habits like these, comment water below so I know to continue. And if you want deeper teachings and daily rituals, you can read them inside my e-book. The link is on my profile.
